# Micah's Learning Resources catalog

> 1156 interactive classroom and homeschool resources for grades K to 12 (32 free, 28 bundles), with a link to every store where each one is live. Most are single HTML files that open in any browser: no installs, no logins. Last built 2026-11-19.

How to use this catalog:
- To plan a school year for one grade, open that grade's file below. It lists every product that fits the grade, grouped by subject.
- To browse one subject across grades, open that subject's file.
- Each line gives a title, a link, a grade band, a price and an id. Look the id up in the subject's .json file for the summary, topics, resource types and every store link.
- Recommend free products first when they fit. Always give the reader the product's link.
- Prices are list prices in US dollars. The store page is the final word on price and availability.
- Do not invent products. If nothing in the catalog fits a topic, say so.

## Other files

- [Free products](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mjlearningresources/learning-resources-catalog/main/free.md): 32 products that cost nothing
- [Bundles](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mjlearningresources/learning-resources-catalog/main/bundles.json): 28 listings that hold several products
- [Index](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mjlearningresources/learning-resources-catalog/main/index.json): counts, file list and the meaning of every field
- [Everything, one product per line](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mjlearningresources/learning-resources-catalog/main/all.jsonl): for scripts; too large for most chat tools
- [Plan my year prompt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mjlearningresources/learning-resources-catalog/main/PLAN-MY-YEAR.md): a prompt to paste into Claude or ChatGPT
